title: A Website Opportunities demo action refused before any paid work gives its daily build back once
steps: S1: Accept a demo action whose brief has no photograph to label and is blocked; drain the runner until it fails BRIEF_NOT_READY; read wo_demo_usage.used and the usage door; run the refund again and record the failure twice.
S2: Accept the same blocked own-site action whose labelling run sends pictures to the paid vision call (beforePaidCall); drain the runner until it fails BRIEF_NOT_READY.
S3: Accept an own-site action whose labelling run is in flight past PICTURE_LABELS_OVERDUE_MS; drain the runner until it fails DEMO_PICTURE_LABELS_TIMEOUT.
S4: Run the demo-actions refund cases: past-day row, own-site kind, build row or site present, quality-v1, and two concurrent presses at the cap after a refund.
expect: S1: wo_demo_action.status failed, error BRIEF_NOT_READY, work_started_at null, no wo_build row; wo_demo_usage.used goes from 1 to 0 and stays 0 after a second refund or a second recorded failure.
S2: wo_demo_action.error BRIEF_NOT_READY, work_started_at set; wo_demo_usage.used stays 1.
S3: wo_demo_action.error DEMO_PICTURE_LABELS_TIMEOUT, work_started_at set; wo_demo_usage.used stays 1.

S4: the refund lowers only the wo_demo_usage row of the action's usage_day and usage_kind, never below 0; an action with a wo_build row, work_started_at or protocol quality-v1 keeps wo_demo_usage.used; at the cap exactly one of two concurrent presses answers 202 and the other 429 DEMO_BUILD_DAILY_LIMIT.
evidence: Issue #564: Portland City Boxing, five actions failed BRIEF_NOT_READY with no wo_build row, and each first press stayed counted in wo_demo_usage.used.
fence: refundUnbilledDemoUsage: failed legacy action, error in UNBILLED_FAILURES, no wo_build row, work_started_at null, usage_refunded_at set once

cmd: --test-name-pattern=#564|BRIEF_NOT_READY|photo-label timeout|refund|daily build|stays charged|refused before its work
tests: a blocked brief starts no build: the action stops BRIEF_NOT_READY and the revision keeps its owner questions
a blocked brief with no photograph to label gives its daily build back (#564)
a blocked brief after its own labelling run sent pictures keeps its daily build (#564)
client-send photo-label timeout fails with its actual cause without freezing a brief or adopting late results
a first press refused BRIEF_NOT_READY gives its daily build back
a refund happens once, however often the failure is recorded or the refund runs
a refund lands on the day it was charged, never on today
an own-site build refused before its work gives back an own-site build
an action that reached a site, failed another way, or ran quality-v1 stays charged
a labels timeout, paid brief work or a build row keeps the daily build
after a refund, two presses at the cap still get exactly one build
